title: Place a footprint and start the interactive move
summary: Creates a component with PCBObjectFactory, loads a footprint from a .PcbLib with LoadFromLibrary, adds it to the board inside PreProcess/PostProcess, selects it and starts the editor's PCB:MoveObject tool so the user drops it with a click.
phrasings: place a footprint from a PcbLib on the board
add a component to a PCB from code
start the move tool on a new component

commands.name: PlaceAndMoveComponent
commands.description: Place a PcbLib footprint and start the interactive move
commands.params: Lib=<.PcbLib path, absolute or relative to the board folder> (default: first .PcbLib in the board folder or a direct subfolder)|Footprint=<name> (default: footprint of the first component on the board)|X=<mil>|Y=<mil> (from the board origin, default 0)|Move=true|false (default true from the menu, false from the pipe)
